responsibility: Declares the shared preprocessor-builtin helpers used by front ends that rely on cpplib, specifically the BASEVER parser and the entry point that installs GCC’s language-independent predefined macros. It is the public interface for the macro-definition logic in cppbuiltin.cc, separating generic builtin macro setup from front-end- or target-specific predefined macro code.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface header for the cppbuiltin pair: it declares parse_basever and the entry point for installing language-independent predefined macros. Unlike gcc/cppbuiltin.cc, it does not define any macros itself; it exposes the implementation for front ends that use cpplib.
